title: Demand Estimation with Variable Choice Sets: A Likelihood Correction for Nested Logit
abstract: arXiv:2609.12987v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We derive the exact likelihood of the Berry (1994) share-form nested logit and show it contains a Jacobian term that depends on nest size and the nesting parameter. Omitting the term biases within-nest substitution estimates wherever choice sets vary across markets. Commonly-used count instruments for the within-nest share fail exclusion when product counts enter demand directly. The corrected likelihood identifies substitution without them, making crowding estimable. We apply the estimator to Medicare Advantage plan proliferation after 2019 elimination of the ``meaningful difference'' requirement. Estimates indicate plan proliferation raised consumer surplus in most markets, but ignoring crowding overstates the gains.

translated_title: 变化选择集下的需求估计：嵌套Logit的似然修正
translated_abstract: 我们推导了Berry (1994)份额形式嵌套Logit的精确似然函数，并证明其中包含一个依赖于巢内产品数量和巢参数的雅可比项。只要选择集在不同市场间存在差异，忽略该项就会使巢内替代估计产生偏差。当产品数量直接进入需求函数时，常用的巢内份额计数工具变量不满足排他性约束。修正后的似然函数无需这些工具变量即可识别替代效应，使拥挤效应可以被估计。我们将该估计量应用于2019年“有意义差异”要求取消后Medicare Advantage计划的扩张问题。估计结果表明，计划扩张在大多数市场提高了消费者剩余，但忽略拥挤效应会高估这些收益。
tldr: 该论文推导出嵌套Logit的精确似然函数，发现其中包含一个此前被忽略的、依赖于巢内产品数量的雅可比修正项，忽略该项会使巢内替代估计产生偏差；修正后的估计无需计数工具变量即可识别拥挤效应，并应用于Medicare Advantage计划扩张分析，发现忽略拥挤效应会高估消费者剩余收益。
en_tdlr: This paper derives the exact likelihood of the Berry (1994) nested logit, revealing a previously omitted Jacobian term that biases within-nest substitution estimates when choice sets vary across markets; the corrected estimator identifies crowding without count instruments and, applied to Medicare Advantage plan proliferation, shows that ignoring crowding overstates consumer surplus gains.
